subject: general
question: Who among the following won her maiden Commonwealth Games gold medal in 62 kg Wrestling at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Sakshi Malik**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sakshi Malik is a **freestyle wrestler** from India.
 
• In 2010 at the Junior World Championships, Malik achieved her** first professional victory **in the international ring when she earned the bronze medal in the 58 kg freestyle competition.
 
• **Sakshi malik** won the** gold medal in 62kg wrestling** at commonwealth games 2022.
 
• This was Sakshi Malik’s **third straight medal** at the CWG.
 
• She won the** 58kg silver at Glasgow 2014 and a bronze at Gold Coast 2018.**
 
• ​Malik currently works for Indian Railways in the Delhi division's commercial department, in the Northern Railway zone. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Kavita Devi:**

 
 
• **Indian professional wrestler **Kavita Dalal competed for the WWE on their developmental network NXT between 2017 and 2021 with the ring name Kavita Devi.
 
• Devi is the first professional female wrestler of Indian descent to compete in the WWE.
 
• Under the ring aliases **Kavita and Hard KD**, Devi has previously competed on the indie scene, most notably for Continental Wrestling Entertainment in India.
 
 
 
• **Babita Kumari:**
 
 
• Babita Kumari Phogat, an **Indian wrestler **who won the gold medal in the 2014 Commonwealth Games, was born on November 20, 1989.
 
• She also received bronze at the **2012 World Wrestling Championships**, silver at the 2018 Commonwealth Games, and silver in the 2010 Commonwealth Games. 
 
• 2019 saw Babita Phogat enter politics by affiliating with the** Bharatiya Janata Party**.
 
 
 
• **Vinesh Phogat:**
 
 
• Vinesh Phogat is an **Indian wrestler** who was born on August 25, 1994.
 
• She became the **first female wrestler** from India to win gold at the Asian and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Only she has won numerous medals at the **World Wrestling Championships** among Indian women wrestlers.
 
• In 2019, Phogat became the first sportsperson from India to be nominated for a Laureus World Sports Award.
